entities.name: Alí Solís
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Román Alí Solís López is a Mexican professional baseball catcher for El Águila de Veracruz of the Mexican League and Tomateros de Culiacán of the Mexican Pacific League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres in 2012 and Tampa Bay Rays in 2014.
